items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: one of those guys that was involved was a good friend and a good tap dancer, a dancer called Eleanor Powell.

ctx.x: He did Spic 'n Spanish, right? That was in 1939, I can tell you exactly, that was in October, 1939.

Right in there, almost -- I don't know who was in, a day before, a month before or a month after. They opened in Martinique (unintelligible) they opened a club. A fellow friend of mine opened the club called the La Conga. And one of those guys that was involved was a good friend and a good tap dancer, a dancer called Eleanor Powell.
